name: Emerald Robot
bio: Polished to a mirror shine. Every scratch is a story, and it remembers every one of them.
notes: Drive, 2026-11-02 ("Emerald Robot", rigged; the owner's download "Meshy_AI_Emerald_Robot_All_Animations.glb", put on disk by the lead with the owner's approval). A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its Walking and Running clips are not used). A CC0 Meshy community model that the owner rigged and animated on their Meshy account (licence per the owner, 2 Nov), recorded like WWII Infantry and the clip set's sources (content/clip-sets/shooter.json). It moves with the shared clip set. Normal map 512 px (the default): at 1024 px the body was over the 1.8 MB file budget. A slim teal-and-grey robot with a boxy camera head, standing arms down in the download. Hands: blocky clamps turned on their joints (measured, mitten); grip audit 0 as built. Name a placeholder.

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
